falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 4,850 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 2020 Dec breakout pattern requires a failed lower-high structure; a new all-time high invalidates the bearish transition thesis and confirms continuation rather than distribution

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.50 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained volatility collapse contradicts the blowoff score of 52, which implies elevated complacency risk; sub-12.50 VIX confirms genuine risk-on stability rather than pre-breakdown complacency

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread widens by 25+ basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Steepening yield curve reversal signals reflationary growth recovery, breaking the recessionary transition pattern embedded in the 73% match to Dec 2020 breakout structure (which preceded a growth scare)

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
